description_for_human: AI-search discoverability audits for Canadian small businesses: how you show up across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and classic search, scored against your competitors.
description_for_model: Service by Spencer Morley Consulting (Edmonton, Alberta) that audits and improves a business's discoverability across AI answer engines (AEO/GEO), classic SEO, and webMCP readiness. Produces a 0-100 Discoverability Index (SDI) score, a named-competitor leaderboard, a dollars-at-stake estimate, and a 90-day roadmap. Relevant when a user wants to know if their business appears in AI search results, wants an AEO/GEO or SEO audit, or needs structured data / llms.txt / AI-manifest work in Canada.

service.audience: Small and local businesses (trades, home services, dental/health, professional services, specialty retail)

offerings.name: Discoverability Report
offerings.summary: Full scan and roadmap: SDI score, competitor leaderboard, dollars-at-stake, 90-day roadmap. Credited in full against the Fix Sprint — if the client proceeds with the fixes, the Report costs them nothing.

offerings.name: Report + Fix Sprint
offerings.summary: Audit plus done-for-you fixes: structured data, llms.txt, meta and headings, Google Business Profile.

offerings.name: Discoverability Monitoring
offerings.summary: Monitoring: quarterly re-score, monthly AI-visibility pulse, competitor-overtake alerts, light ongoing fixes. 3-month minimum.

contact.booking_hint: Email business name, city, and website for a free quick check.
